limits: Synthetic fixtures; no general claim for every user project.
CPU is process time; wave/inspection/preview include setup and warmup; export pairs use a timed CPU delta.
RSS includes warmup and integrity probes where executed; no separate system media-service or GPU memory accounting.
Timeline numbers measure Path construction, not GUI FPS.
Cold inspection means waveform caches cleared, not OS file-cache eviction.
Preview first/warm both start from a ready player; warm adds an appearance cycle.
Long 30min exports run at 1fps; 1h/30fps coverage is overlay-only, not a full encoded export.
4K baseline caption exports stopped under a 768MiB harness guard; no before/after speed comparison.
Native GUI post-resize verification remains blocked by the locked Mac.

limitations: Baseline full sequence and long exports did not complete under the harness RSS guard; do not compare their full durations or extrapolate them.
Baseline short 4K export hit the guard in 5/5 runs; no before/after 4K export speed claim.
The second half of current full 4K sequence overlapped point6 compile/functional tests; use it only for completion counters and memory.
These synthetic fixtures do not estimate a production user project or 1fps results at 30fps.

exportResolution.pixelToleranceRule: Candidate MAE, RMSE and max RGB error must not exceed the same-case native baseline repeat.
exportResolution.speedRule: All five pairs must improve; median paired saving must exceed 3x max MAD and 1% of native median.
